_description: Command-classifier front end (2026-09-30). Same feature definition as the wakeword front end (../../preprocessing/preprocessing_config.json), with a 5 s window. Keys starting with '_' are documentation.
_window_sec: A capture is 0.3 s pre-roll + up to 3 s wait + command + 1.0 s of quiet; owner captures are 1.5-8.1 s (median 3.3 s). 5 s covers every complete capture of a command said within ~1.5 s of the chime; longer ones (max_length, speech over a TV) are cut at 5 s, keeping the start, where the command is.
_pad: Shorter clips are padded on the RIGHT with Gaussian noise at the measured median RPI floor (not zeros): exact digital silence never occurs on the device, and a zero run would tell the model how long the clip was.
_short_clip_placement: A capture always starts at the wake-up; the command position relative to the start is information the device also has.
_long_clip_policy: Unused: command_preprocessing.frame_command crops to the first 5 s instead.
_features: 25 ms Hann window, 10 ms hop, 40 HTK mel bins 20-7600 Hz, power, 10*log10 with a fixed floor (no per-clip top_db, so absolute level is kept): [1, 40, 497] per 5 s clip.
